title: NAS security parameters from E-UTRA information element

fields.name: NAS security parameters from E-UTRA IEI
DL NAS COUNT value (short)
fields.description: Contains the 4 least significant bits of the binary representation of the downlink NAS COUNT value applicable when this information element is sent

notes: The NAS security parameters from E-UTRA is a type 3 information element with a length of 2 octets
Bit 5 to 8 of octet 2 are spare and shall be coded as zero
